decisive_spans.text: Nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots
Cell differential: 1% lymphocytes, 1% monocytes/macrophages, 98% atypical cells/blasts
Diffuse heterogeneous T1- and T2-weighted signal abnormalities within the bone marrow

response.rationale: D6 (Neurolymphomatosis) is strongly supported by the combination of severe flaccid quadriparesis, reduced muscle stretch reflexes, atypical cells/blasts in CSF, nodular thickening and enhancement of lumbosacral nerve roots, violaceous cutaneous lesions (leukemia cutis), and diffuse heterogeneous T1- and T2-weighted signal abnormalities within the bone marrow. D2 (Leukemia) is supported by leukemia cutis and atypical cells/blasts, but does not encompass the neurological findings as comprehensively as D6.
